integrity: Every labeled tournament through order five is enumerated. The Slater set is computed by both permutation enumeration and subset dynamic programming; the Markov stationary vector is computed by both exact rational linear algebra and directed matrix-tree cofactors; every divergent tournament is canonicalized under all alternative relabelings.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite classification through the first Slater-Markov disparity order. The order-five disparity threshold is prior work, and no frequency or structural formula for larger tournaments is claimed.
title: Complete first disparity layer for the Slater and Markov tournament solutions
